identification: Vintage Chinese 3-tier woven cane/rattan and bamboo lidded wedding (betrothal) food basket with tall arched bamboo handle, used as a sewing box and holding a tin of sewing supplies, pincushion, knitting needles, a mini Oxford dictionary. Plain natural finish, not lacquered, no carving or brass seen. Likely mid 20th century. Identification carried from the ID pass (2 photos, no marks); photos not re-opened as the ID is clear and not value-critical.

viewing_check: Armitage estimate 30-40, current bid $15 (re-checked 9 Nov), 22% premium. Check condition (cracks, loose weave, missing lid, mould or smell) and whether it has a lacquer finish or carved handle, which lifts the price. Plain 3-tier baskets sold A$27 to A$95 on eBay AU (typical about A$65 to A$85), plus postage around A$14 to A$15 paid by the buyer. All sales within 18 months (2025 to Oct 2026); prices steady. It is bulky to post.
